note: The earliest stage able to catch each review code (review-stages.mjs). A final-review finding whose code maps to an earlier stage is an escape: delivery records it in delivery.json and the run log, by code and page, as the evidence for which first loop to deepen next. The stages, earliest first: renderer (a default draws it right), page-gate (a compile or render gate on one page measures it), spine (the storyline critique, the plan and the self-check read it from the titles, claims and records before anything is drawn), section-review (a reader of one section's rendered pages sees it), final-review (only the whole deck shows it). A test fails when a reviewer code (reviewer.mjs CODES, the R class of gates/gate_classes.mjs) has no stage here.

FACTUAL_ERROR.why: a number, name or date is checked against its record by the storyline critique and the self-check, before it is drawn (reviewer.mjs CODES_AT_SPINE)

UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM.why: whether the evidence carries the claim is decided from the claim, its insights and its measures at the spine

MISLEADING_COMPARISON.why: bases, units and periods compared are in the measures the spine packet shows

UNCLEAR_ARGUMENT.why: a page's job in the argument is read from the titles in order and each page's claim

HEDGED_TITLE.why: the title is the claim, read whole at the spine

UNREADABLE.why: type size, clipping and contrast are measured on the composed page

OVERFLOW.why: content past its box is measured on the composed and rendered page

BROKEN_GEOMETRY.why: overlaps, text on lines and orphaned marks are measured on the composed page

PROVENANCE.why: a source line, its date and its footnotes are read on the drawn page

DEAD_SPACE.why: an empty band is measured on the composed page (SCENE_VOID, DEAD_BAND)

NO_HERO_EXHIBIT.why: the exhibit's share of the content frame is measured on the composed page (HERO_EXHIBIT)

OVERSIZED_TYPE.why: type sizes come from the deck's type scale, which the renderer sets

WALL_OF_TEXT.why: a page's words against its ceiling are measured at the compile

BURIED_NUMBER.why: whether the decisive number sits on a mark or in a sentence is seen on one rendered page

INCONSISTENT_ENCODING.why: the same measure drawn differently across pages shows only across the deck

NO_VISUAL_ANCHOR.why: a missing logo, picture or map is seen on the page that needs it

UNANNOTATED_PLOT.why: whether an annotation marks the finding is read on the rendered chart

TABLE_MONOTONY.why: repeated table grammar shows only across pages

MIXED_GRAMMAR.why: two grammars sharing one page are seen on that page

DECORATION.why: a rule or band that says nothing is seen on its page

NARROW_REPERTOIRE.why: the deck's exhibit range is counted on the plan (VARIETY_EXHIBIT_RANGE) before the copy is written

TRIVIAL_CHART.why: a chart of two or three values is counted at the compile (CRAFT_TRIVIAL_CHARTS)

NO_INSIGHT_CHART.why: whether the chart makes its implication visible is read on the rendered page

DEVICE_OVERUSE.why: one construction carrying pages of different shapes shows across the deck

FLAT_TABLE.why: whether a judging table encodes its judgement is read on the rendered table

MISSING_CONTEXT.why: a player compared before it is introduced is read from the page order and its evidence (the critique's flow check)

MAP_DESIGN.why: placed cities, fills, markers and routes are read on the rendered map

DENSITY_MISMATCH.why: a page's words against its reading task are measured by the page check's render and judged on the page

EDITORIAL.why: a wording preference is read in the page's own lines

MISSING_ANALYSIS.why: the storyline critique raises it on the spine

CUT_PAGE.why: the storyline critique raises it on the spine

MERGE_PAGES.why: the storyline critique raises it on the spine

SUMMARY_UNPROVED.why: the storyline critique reads the summary against the body's claims

SELF_CHECK_INCOMPLETE.why: each section is self-checked beside its section review (references/parallel-run.md stage 5)

MISSING_RENDERED_GATES.why: the rendered page gates are the build's

STORYLINE_UNREVIEWED.why: the storyline critique is held before any page is drawn

REVIEW_PASS_CAP.why: the cap of the final review's own loop

INVALID_REVIEW.why: a final-review answer that does not validate

REVIEW_RATING.why: the final review's rating of the whole deck

REVIEW_PROVENANCE.why: the final review's answer against its own packet

REVIEW_UNCONFIRMED.why: the confirmation read of the final artifact

JUDGEMENTS_OPEN.why: each section's judge reads beside its self-check and section review (stage 5)

observed.note: Codes reviewers coined on real runs (ba4's review), classed so an escape reads them by what they are. A coined code not listed here is read by the gate class of a gate code it reuses (P and G: page-gate, S: spine), then by the finding's scope and dimension.

COUNTER_EVIDENCE_OMITTED.why: the counter-case is in the insights the spine packet shows

COUNT_MISMATCH.why: a counted claim against the rows that count it is read from titles and claims

MISSING_TRIGGER.why: the close's conditions are read in the summary check

REDUNDANT_PAGE.why: the restatement check reads pages that re-prove one another

REPEATED_JOB.why: the restatement check reads pages that do one job

DATED_SNAPSHOT.why: a measure's period is in the record the spine shows

MISSING_EVIDENCE.why: evidence too thin for its claim is the shape check at the spine

MISSING_MEMBER.why: members compared on one measure is the shape check at the spine

UNCLEAR_SCOPE.why: a claim's scope is read with its measures at the spine

UNRECONCILED_FIGURE.why: a figure against its record is the numbers check

UNSIZED_FIGURE.why: a figure with no size or base is read with its measure at the spine

DISTORTED_TIME_AXIS.why: columns and timelines are spaced by time by default

UNEQUAL_TIME_SPACING.why: columns and timelines are spaced by time by default

GAP_BRIDGED.why: a line is broken at a missing period by default

INTERPOLATED_GAP.why: a line or area is broken at a missing period by default

TRUNCATED_AREA_BASELINE.why: an area is filled from zero by default

NUMBER_FORMAT.why: a value prints in the format its measure's record sets (value-format.mjs)

MISSING_PAGE_NUMBERS.why: page numbers are the slide chrome's

SUBJECT_NOT_HIGHLIGHTED.why: the subject the deck's conventions name is drawn in the accent by default

INCONSISTENT_PRECISION.why: a value printed past or short of its record's precision is the dependency gate's (PRECISION_UNRECORDED)

UNRECONCILED_BRIDGE.why: a bridge's steps against its ends is arithmetic on the page's values

EMPTY_CELLS.why: an empty table cell is counted on the composed table

DUPLICATED_UNIT.why: a unit printed in the header and every cell is read from the composed table

ORPHAN_WRAP.why: a line that wraps a word alone is measured on the composed text

TITLE_WIDOW.why: a title's last line of one word is measured on the composed title

DISTORTED_ENCODING.why: a mark sized against its value is seen on the rendered chart

MISATTACHED_ANNOTATION.why: an annotation on the wrong mark is seen on the rendered chart

PICTOGRAM_UNIT_MISMATCH.why: a pictogram's unit against its value is read on the page

UNSCALED_POSITIONING.why: marks placed off their scale are seen on the rendered exhibit

UNLABELLED_COMPARATOR.why: a comparator with no label is seen on the page

DUPLICATE_CONTENT.why: one table or text printed twice on a page is seen on that page

MISSING_TOTAL.why: a table's total is read on the rendered table

TABLE_FORMAT.why: alignment and rounding are read on the rendered table

UNENCODED_STATUS.why: a status cell in words is seen on the rendered table

WRONG_EXHIBIT_FORM.why: the form against its comparison is read on the rendered exhibit

MISSING_PERIOD.why: a figure printed with no period is read in the page's lines

RESTATED_EXHIBIT.why: a sentence restating the exhibit is read beside it

TITLE_RESTATED.why: a line restating the title is read on the page

INCONSISTENT_FORMAT.why: one measure in two formats shows across pages

INCONSISTENT_NUMBER_FORMAT.why: one measure in two formats shows across pages

REPEATED_CONSTRUCTION.why: a construction repeated across neighbouring pages shows across the deck
